prompt:
Hi — our data engineering team left us with a real mess. We have three months of fragmented sales records sitting in separate folders under `data/raw/sales/`, and we need them combined into a single enriched report. Each monthly file has the same columns, but they each have their own header row, so any naive combination will have duplicate headers in the middle of the file. Once the sales records are stacked cleanly, they need to be enriched with the regional metadata from `data/raw/metadata/regions.csv` — the shared key between the two is the `region_id` column. Save the final enriched result as `enriched_sales.csv`.

Separately, we have three service configuration fragments spread across `data/raw/configs/service_a/config.json`, `service_b/config.json`, and `service_c/config.json`. These need to be combined into a single `merged_config.json` — but it must be a true deep merge, not a shallow one, meaning nested objects like `database`, `features`, and `logging` must have ALL their properties from all three sources preserved and overlaid correctly (later files override earlier ones on conflicting scalar values, but no nested keys should be lost). Please produce both output files.
